card.title: Rescue Me by Needing Me
card.instruction: Take protective control, then let each consequence reveal how much your confidence depends on remaining necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me your landlord's number. I'll get your deposit back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Already done, Mum. I'm taking you out to celebrate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me book. You still need someone who checks the reviews.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked your favourite. Just bring yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not even a cake? Could you forget your reading glasses? I could read you the menu.

mechanism: A repeatedly takes care of an adult child until solved needs expose a wish to manufacture one small dependence.
confusable: Unlike an efficient helper, A must falter when practical rescue is no longer required.
comparison: S232-b requests forgotten glasses as a job; S232-a needs a pause to remember companionship without fixing.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
